summary:
# NOTES: "The Princess of the Atom" by Ray Cummings (Avon reprint 1950; orig. 1929 Munsey). Single novel, no multiple BOOK headings.

## Front matter / ad copy
- Dedication: to son Hal and son-in-law Russ, both chemists.
- Blurb: giants off New England coast the day Dianne returns from oblivion; guardian Dr. Ferrule; "princess of a world too small to be seen"; Frank's journey into infinite smallness; Drake fights "lustful Togaro, the man who would rule the universe." Editor Donald A. Wollheim (AVON FANTASY READER).
- Chapter list: I Coming of the Giants; II Mysterious Visitor; III Signal Fire; IV Strange Island; V Princess of the Atom; VI Chase into Smallness; VII Flight in the Cellular Caverns; VIII Death of the Giants; IX Tiny Fragment of Rock; X White Flag; XI Giant in Ambush; XII Meeting; XIII Stowaway; XIV Locked Door; XV Togaro at Bay; XVI Frank's Plan; XVII Tiny Prowler; XVIII Escape of Togaro; XIX Night of Turmoil; XX In the Blood Light of Dawn; XXI Riding the Giant; XXII "Vengeance of Togaro!"; XXIII Doomed Little Planet!; XXIV End of a World; XXV In the Campfire Light; XXVI Black and White Flags; XXVII Fight on the Rock Summit; XXVIII Return to Earth; XXIX Theft of the Rock; XXX World at Bay; XXXI Togaro Strikes; XXXII Fugitives; XXXIII Combat of Titans; XXXIV Princess of the Cottage.

## Prologue (narrator Frank Ferrule, age 17 at the time)
- Family: father (Dr. Ferrule, consulting chemist, ~50, iron-gray hair, horn-rimmed spectacles, nervous, cautious); mother (died when Frank a child); brother Drake (6 yrs older, 6'2", blond, good-natured "huge dog"); sister Dianne (blue eyes, flaxen hair as child, later pale-gold hair, exquisite beauty); Frank small, slender, dark hair, "terrier."
- Dianne's forehead: hair grew in a queer peak at center; she parted it to one side; crescent-shaped silver-sheen patch on forehead, hidden.
- Summer home on Maine coast; cove; Bird's Nest Island (~2 miles offshore, few hundred acres, 50-ft rock peak, spring of water, signal flag/cairn from childhood).
- Aug 14: Dianne (16) vanished on island while swimming/shallows. Frank had grabbed her hair at forehead; she cried "Frank, stop that! Let me go!" Clothes left on beach. No boat seen.
- Father's revelation: ~15 years earlier (Frank ~2, Drake ~8), father and mother found infant girl (~1 yr) on Bird's Nest Island, in thicket, wrapped in gold gossamer robe with tiny hood. Named Dianne by mother. Father shows robe in drawer. Father: "wondered if she were just exactly human."
- Day lost = 5 years before the giants.

## Ch I – Coming of the Giants
- March 20: small steamship out of Halifax (bound Portland) rounds Cape Sable, NS; giant seen wading, bullet-headed, pale hair, ~60-ft body above water. Later reports ~50–300 ft.
- Newspapers mock. Late March: second giant near Penobscot/Bird's Nest; wades toward Bay of Fundy. Panic in Boston; martial law Maine coast.
- Frank: pilot, International Mail Service (Boston–St. John). Chief orders night patrol. Frank + relief pilot Bob Jones + radio operator Green; plane flies Boston to NB border.
- Near Frank's cove: giant at cove mouth, hand on 100-ft headland; kills two people on cliff with arm sweep. Giant shrinks, swims toward Bird's Nest, dives, doesn't resurface.
- Radio: father sent message; land at Bennett Field, NY. "He has heard from Dianne."

## Ch II – Mysterious Visitor
- Westchester cottage near village. Just before midnight, thumping at door. Tall bulky man, long dark overcoat, black felt hat, foreign soft voice, heavy jaw, hairless, ~35. Stooped under doorway; massive bullet head, pale gold close-cut hair, slate-blue eyes, high-bridged nose, square chin, thin lips. Drake (28, afraid of no man) confronts.
- Visitor: "You had a daughter--" "Yes, Dianne." "Forget her." "I came to warn you... stay away from your house in Maine... giants... must be dangerous." Leaves; hat on backward; runs off.

## Ch III – Signal Fire
- Frank arrives ~6 hrs later. Father theorizes visitor was a giant. Father, Drake, Frank fly official plane to Maine; Elton village two miles away under military rule. Father sick-prone, sleeps with automatic.
- Night guard: Drake and Frank. Reports: farmer dead, clothes stolen. Dawn: smoke signal from Bird's Nest, two large puffs then three smaller = childhood signal.

## Ch IV – Strange Island
- Drake, Frank row to island (dory, oilskins). Burned embers; wet sticks. Tiny figures in grass. Dianne (finger-height, golden robe) "Dianne, it's you!"

## Ch V – Princess of the Atom
- Dianne: "You came, Frank. I--we've been waiting." Companion Ahlma (silver-white robe, paler crescent, slight accent like Togaro's). Dianne grows to normal size. Says "Togaro... leader" is here with men; "jungle deeps" etc.
- Dianne's story: Mita-world inside an atom in a meteorite buried on Bird's Nest Island; princess; parents sent her to Earth by drug and flying vehicle to escape conqueror Togaro. Togaro learned English from her, came to Earth; tried to take her; she was rescued and is now ruler.
- Father: Togaro's hordes plan invasion. Plan: get rock fragment ("atom"), keep it at home guarded.
- Togaro (the midnight visitor) appears small in the room; both Frank and Drake saw him.

## Ch VI – Chase into Smallness
- Drug pellets from phial; Dianne, Frank, Drake shrink; Father and Ahlma stay. Landscape of bedroom floor = cellular caves (knothole, boards). Togaro lures them into a 200-ft cavern. Dianne: "Oh, Drake, you took too much!" Drake had gulped whole pellet.

## Ch VII – Flight in the Cellular Caverns
- Drake and Togaro fight, grow giant, climb through roof hole to upper surface; Drake knocked out. Togaro, as large as Father, fights father and Ahlma. Ahlma flings lamp; dark; Togaro flees house.
- Frank & Dianne at home; Dianne says with the gold dress and crescent; Togaro left. Ahlma/father talk: "What a handsome young man your son Drake is."

## Ch VIII – Death of the Giants
- Afternoon: Frank talks with Dianne; Drake with Ahlma ("You saved my life"). Night: Frank, Drake to island with father following to boathouse. Meteorite buried in soil with projecting rock; Dianne shows crater; Frank chips off fragment with knife. Lightning; six giants on island; dory crushed. Battle: battleship, planes; giants killed; one reaches mainland, falls 10 miles down coast.
- Dianne tells Frank to chip; Drake shrinks away. Frank hides with fragment; Frank taken by men in boat ("Ferrule. My name is Frank Ferrule. ... King's Cove.")

## Ch IX – Tiny Fragment of Rock
- A year later. Frank & father live at King's Cove; fragment guarded in barred room with three guards. Giants: no drugs found; belts with empty compartments. Father's health poor; Drake presumed lost.
- May night: a man climbs out, waving white flag: "Frank" recognized?

## Ch X – White Flag
- Room: granite slab 6 ft square, dome light, microscope, poison atomizers. Guard Foley. Man "Alt" (tiny, bloody) says "Don't--kill me! Friend--friend--from Drake." Father: Alt has drug belt. Alt grows to Frank's size. Plan: Alt sent back "with Frank" to Drake; Dianne, Ahlma waiting in flying car.

## Ch XI – Giant in Ambush
- Frank prepares: bathing suit, drug belt, automatics (four), knives. Alt's feet wrapped. Father lifts Frank and Alt onto flat slab; father sets them in pit. Frank's shoelace tug; crawling insect-feeling (later meaning: Togaro on Frank's shoe/shoulder). Father's signal flag: black and white stripes.
- Valley, crescent pit; giant from Togaro's men; Frank shoots giant in shoulder; hides in cleft; second shot.
- Later: Togaro-sized small man clings to Frank's belt and escapes (Togaro).

## Ch XII – Meeting
- Sandwich; mountains; vast metallic plain, drizzle. Drake's red signal light. Reunion: Drake, Dianne (kisses Frank), Ahlma. Frank: Dianne "no princess this. Just a girl!"

## Ch XIII – Stowaway
- Wire-woven interplanetary vehicle (40 ft; elliptical windows); Drake explains; Togaro's leaders (~100) with ~half-million followers; Togaro's stowaway steals automatic via tiny figure; "Togaro!"; escapes.

## Ch XIV – Locked Door
- Voyage ~15–20 hrs; into molecules; astronomical space; Drake's spectrometer. Sleep. Return: guard murdered with bodkin-sword. Girls' door locked.

## Ch XV – Togaro at Bay
- Ahlma unconscious; Dianne gone with Togaro. Alt/Drake/Frank break door. Togaro's laugh: "Come in and get us--if you dare!"

## Ch XVI – Frank's Plan
- Door broken; Togaro wedged, holds Dianne; threatens with enlarging drug and Ahlma's... Frank's plan: Frank shrinks, ride Togaro (signal from Drake). Frank takes diminishing drug. Hour before landing.

## Ch XVII – Tiny Prowler
- Frank shrinks on grid floor; Drake's hand signal; Frank climbs Togaro's trousers; lets go; grows, clings to belt.

## Ch XVIII – Escape of Togaro
- Drake: "Dianne! Togaro, sit still or I'll kill you." Togaro grows out through ceiling, leaps to ground; Frank clinging to belt.

## Ch XIX – Night of Turmoil
- Mita: 300-mile-diameter globe, day ~3h20m; capital Shore City on lake; council; Jain (huge black-coated official). Drake leads; Ahlma; Alt. Crowd demands drugs. Palace in garden.

## Ch XX – In the Blood Light of Dawn
- Togaro's ship on island; crowd chant "The world ends tonight! Give us the drugs!" Drake/Ahlma/Alt enlarge onto palace balcony. Giants rise at dawn; exodus; ship expands; Mita's destruction.

## Ch XXI – Riding the Giant
- Frank rides Togaro to island camp; Dianne placed in cabin; Frank rope-climb to window; ride continues.

## Ch XXII – "Vengeance of Togaro!"
- Frank reaches Dianne; she hides him in robe; Togaro's threats: "Vengeance of Togaro. Ten million people die."

## Ch XXIII – Doomed Little Planet!
- Togaro's ship swung near Mita's sun; Mita flung into fall.

## Ch XXIV – End of a World
- Drake's struggle; ~110,000 refugees to ship; Mita falls into its sun, fused.

## Ch XXV – In the Campfire Light
- Outbound to Earth (~40,000 followers). Landing in forest. Frank in Mitan jacket and hat. Dianne at fire with Togaro; Frank strikes Togaro with rock; escape.

## Ch XXVI – Black and White Flags
- Frank and Dianne in abyss; black/white striped flag; Drake, Ahlma, Alt reunited. Rock fragment stolen; room is different.

## Ch XXVII – Fight on the Rock Summit
- Four Togarite guards; fight; Alt stabbed (bar in side), bodies hidden.

## Ch XXVIII – Return to Earth
- Frank, Drake, Dianne, Ahlma, Alt; hidden room; Togaro arrives; Togarites pour out; they escape to King's Cove boathouse (night).

## Ch XXIX – Theft of the Rock
- May 14 recap: Togaro hid on Frank; Foley killed; father struck by flagstaff; fragment gone. Togarites take King's Cove May 20–21.

## Ch XXX – World at Bay
- May 21 giants rise at King's Cove; Elton; Portland (May 23) occupied; Lynn destroyed; battleship sunk by Togaro; Canadian planes downed by slingshots.

## Ch XXXI – Togaro Strikes
- Giants advance to Connecticut (June 1); New Haven trampled; Bear Mountain Bridge; Togaro at Sandy Hook (June 2): wrecks Staten Island forts, Lower Manhattan; demands surrender, planes at Hook. Mount Vernon call: Drake: "Don't yield! We're coming with the drugs." Attack on New Jersey border; Dianne seen in golden robe rising from sea.

## Ch XXXII – Fugitives
- Frank, Drake, Dianne, Ahlma flee; barn; days wandering; near Norwalk. Dianne runs at night, takes drug, grows.

## Ch XXXIII – Combat of Titans
- Drake and Ahlma escape, reach Mount Vernon; Drake telephones message. Frank pursues; Dianne and Frank wade Sound; Dianne fights Togaro in water; Frank fights Togaro; Togaro swallows poison, drops rock fragment into sea—Mitan world lost. Togaro dies falling across Highlands/Lower Bay.

## Ch XXXIV – Princess of the Cottage
- A year later. Togarites (~40,000) isolated on an island. Drugs destroyed. Togaro's body sunk. Frank & Dianne living at cottage by sea; Drake & Ahlma nearby; father in NY. Dianne playing housekeeping; clams; signal fire; "Frank Ferrule, you can make your own smoke signals... I'm going to bed." THE END.

## Back matter
- Ad copy: "Atomic Napoleon"; "Empire State Building" giants; Ray Cummings "dean of fantasy," assistant to Thomas A. Edison.
